(sum by (qiniu_account) (increase(qiniu_exporter_api_rate_limit_events_total{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range])) and on(qiniu_account) max by (qiniu_account) (up{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1)) or on(qiniu_account) (0 * max by (qiniu_account) (up{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1))

panels.description: No data is expected until the selected exporter has made an upstream API attempt in the displayed time range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (qiniu_account, service, host, le) (rate(qiniu_exporter_api_limiter_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Local Limiter Wait p95

panels.description: Persistent gate rows explain collectors intentionally disabled by validation or allowlist settings. A lone account-level zero means no active gates. Non-gate rows are scheduler skips added during the selected time range.

targets.expr: ((sum by (qiniu_account, module, collector, reason) (qiniu_exporter_scheduler_skipped_total{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",reason=~"timezone_unverified|units_unverified|allowlist_empty"}) > bool 0) and on(qiniu_account) max by (qiniu_account) (up{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1)) or on(qiniu_account) (0 * max by (qiniu_account) (up{qiniu_account=~"${qiniu_account:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1))
